title: GOD HEARS OUR REJECTION OF HIM

memory_verse.label: Bible Reference
memory_verse.text: "Tell the people: 'Consecrate yourselves in preparation for tomorrow, when you will eat meat. The Lord heard you when you wailed, "If only we had meat to eat! We were better off in Egypt!" Now the Lord will give you meat, and you will eat it. You will not eat it for just one day, or two days, or five, ten or twenty days, but for a whole month — until it comes out of your nostrils and you loathe it — because you have rejected the Lord, who is among you, and have wailed before him, saying, "Why did we ever leave Egypt?"'" — Num 11:18-20 (NIV)

devotion.label: Devotion
devotion.text:
God gives the people exactly what they demanded — and it becomes a warning. They wanted meat, and they would get meat until they were sick of it. Sometimes God's discipline comes not by withholding what we crave but by granting it in a way that exposes how empty it was.

The heart of the matter is named clearly: their wailing was not really about food. "You have rejected the Lord, who is among you." Their craving revealed a deeper rot — they preferred slavery with full stomachs to freedom with God. To say "we were better off in Egypt" was to spit at the very grace that had saved them.

This should make us pause. Our complaints are rarely just about circumstances. Underneath, they often reveal what we truly trust and truly want. When we say "I would be happier if only I had…," we are quietly telling God that He is not enough.

Be careful what you demand from God. Sometimes the most sobering answer to a selfish prayer is "yes." The gospel invites us to a better prayer — not "give me what I crave," but "make my heart content in You." Christ came so that we would hunger for God Himself, not merely His gifts.

reflection.label: Reflection
reflection.text:
1. What do your complaints reveal about what you truly want?
2. Have you ever received something you demanded, only to find it empty?
3. How can you learn to desire God more than His gifts?

prayer.label: Prayer
prayer.text: Lord, search my heart and show me where my cravings have crowded You out. Teach me to want You above all things, and to find Egypt's comforts hollow next to Your presence. Amen.
